criteria: PASS requires ALL of: (a) >=11/15 tickers beat the constant baseline in >=3/4 folds; (b) pooled mean relative improvement across ticker-folds > +0.02; (c) panel pooled mean improvement exceeds the aligned per-ticker control; (d) shuffled-label and shifted-label controls on the best config have median relative improvement within +/-0.02 of 0 and do not pass (a); (e) block-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 on the pooled paired improvement (alpha=0.05, trials_in_family=1). Evaluator may short-circuit and record negative if (a),(b) or (c) fail; (d)/(e) are computed only for a candidate that clears them. mechanism: Pooling all 15 tickers multiplies the effective training sample from ~1,170 to ~17,500 rows per fold while per-ticker feature standardisation keeps each ticker's inputs on a common scale. The mechanism is variance reduction: a pooled ridge/logistic should estimate the same feature-to-target mapping with less noise, which should show up first in the only currently skilful target, fwd_volume_ratio.
metric: per-target relative improvement vs constant baseline (RMSE for regression, log-loss for classification) across 4 walk-forward folds; primary target fwd_volume_ratio
negative: Panel pooled model fails (a)-(e) on fwd_volume_ratio: it does not beat the constant baseline consistently across tickers and folds, or does not beat the aligned per-ticker reference, or the CI includes zero. Record negative; do not touch the final holdout.
